feeds.title: The Soap Coach Blog
feeds.description: Blog from The Soap Coach with soap making information, advice, resources and more. My name is Keri and I am your magic wand. Whether you are new to soap making, an old hand, a soap business owner or want to be owner my mission to is to provide whatever it is that you need, to move you forward in your soap making journey.

feeds.title: Ruth Romano Blog
feeds.description: The Ruth Romano blog teaches you everything you need to learn about soap making and more. Ruth Romano offers handmade soap and soap making courses. All the products are created with delicious vitamin enriched oils, butters and essential oils to nourish and care for your skin as nature intended.

feeds.title: TheSoaperyUK Blog
feeds.description: At The Soapery, we stock a range of Natural oils. We provide Essential Oils & All other Soap Making Ingredients and Equipment at Wholesale Prices. The Soapery was started in Ipswich, UK by Andy Knowles in 2014. We source the finest natural ingredients from around the world, bring them together in simple packaging, and deliver them to your door.

feeds.title: Peak Soap Blog
feeds.description: Here you can read the Handmade Soap blog from Peak Soap. Find advice and help with skincare, ingredients and natural cosmetics. The foundation of Peak Soap was laid down by Dr. Richard Holloway, a medical practitioner and respiratory specialist who treated thousands of miners in Derbyshire in England. He carried out groundbreaking research demonstrating that petrochemicals in household products contributed to skin ageing and respiratory problems.

feeds.title: Aroma Natural Blog
feeds.description: Check out my blog to get lots of soap and skincare recipes. Lifestyle hints and tips. How to make soap, skincare products and perfume. Artisan, handmade soap is a luxury we all can enjoy. Making soap is a magical experience, whether you want to make soap for yourself, friends or start your own soapery it is a brilliant craft to choose, with very little outlay. Visit the Aroma Natural website to know more.

feeds.title: The Soap Mine
feeds.description: I'm Vicki and I'm a Soapaholic. I first made soap in 2009, and it soon became a hobby, which quickly became an obsession. I love making it, reading about it, looking at pictures of it and watching videos about it. I hope you enjoy reading about my soaping adventures do stop and say hi if you pop in you'll be very welcome!

feeds.title: The Maldon Soap Company Blog
feeds.description: Here you'll find product information and ingredient spotlights along with all the soapy news and even some of my random jottings. So put the kettle on, put your feet up and have a browse through the subject that takes your fancy. My name's Sue McKenna and I'm the owner and creator of The Maldon Soap Company.

feeds.title: Soap School Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find soap making and natural cosmetics resources to empower you to start your own cosmetics business. Soap School is a dedicated soap making, toiletries and cosmetics company focusing on teaching people the joys of these traditional arts.

feeds.title: Little Blue Hen Savonnerie Blog
feeds.description: Take a look behind the scenes of the Little Blue Hen Soap Savonnerie. Ethics, environment, fun, science & soap! Little Blue Hen Savonnerie is the original, award winning vegan skincare, hair care and soap business. Specializing in artisan style, traditionally made soaps, bath, hair and skincare products using natural ingredients, established in 2012.

feeds.title: Gartur Stitch Farm Blog » Soap Making
feeds.description: Learn about soap making and how you can achieve natural beauty with the help of the Gartur Stitch Farm Blog. We are a small regenerative farm at the edge of the Scottish Highlands. We believe in the transformative power of making, doing and community.

feeds.title: Soapology Blog
feeds.description: Beautiful handcrafted artisan soap bars made with 100% natural ingredients. We contribute towards homeless charities and are also palm oil free. Soapology was established in 2011 by Emma Grosse. Based in Nottinghamshire, Soapology retail their Handcrafted Artisan Soaps via their website and also sell wholesale to selected retailers across the UK nationwide.

feeds.title: Little Soap Company Blog
feeds.description: Come back here each week to keep up to date with the Little Soap Company blog, our latest product launches, product info & exciting news! The Little Soap Company are totally bonkers countrypreneur who left a career in television and media behind to have a go at building an honest, natural soap brand.

feeds.title: The Soap Foundry Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Soap Foundry blog to know about soap making and how you can create handmade soaps for gifting or using them for yourself. Our goal is to supply products without any derivatives of palm or palm oil, however this is not always possible. Our partners are committed to using sustainable, ethical certified RSPO wherever possible.

feeds.title: Pretty Savage
feeds.description: Our blog provides all the latest news from Pretty Savage Soaps. Whether you are starting your day, or ending it, Pretty Savage is your daily reminder to treat yourself with care. Our mission is to bring you quality, effective skincare that does not require plastic packaging.

feeds.title: The Clovelly Soap Blog
feeds.description: Founder of The Clovelly Soap Company, welcome to Sarah Harper's Blog on Natural Soap, Skincare and Aromatherapy. All their products have been lovingly formulated by her in their studio in Higher Clovelly using the finest oils, home grown herbs and locally foraged sea weeds.

feeds.title: Labre's Hope Blog
feeds.description: Labre's Hope strive to end homelessness through employment in ethically made sustainable cosmetics. We provide jobs to people experiencing homelessness using soap as vehicle for positive change in our community. Supporting us by purchasing our luxury soap not only provides work it benefits our employees mental health.

feeds.title: The Great British Soap Company Blog
feeds.description: Visit our soap blog for news & updates from The Great British Soap Company. The UKs' first all natural soap company to use nothing but UK grown & produced ingredients. The all natural British soap company creates probably the UKs' best natural soap bars using the best quality natural ingredients grown only on British farms, all packaged in recycled packaging sustainably made in England from post consumer waste.

feeds.title: Bee Clean Soaps Blog
feeds.description: Discover a wide range of resources on sustainable soap making, the hidden life of bees and how to be more eco-friendly from home. Bee Clean Soaps has a passion for ethical production and the environment around us to bring high quality, all-natural and sustainable soap bars to homes in our community.
